aspect: The bar moves after you clear it
description: The requirement rises over a working life, so the credential that admitted you does not admit the next person, and may not readmit you.

aspect: You commit before you can evaluate
description: The decision is made at seventeen or eighteen, about a labour market fifteen years out, advised by people whose experience is a generation stale.
energy_note: A bet placed before you knew what betting was.

description: She retrains at 31 into a field that is hiring. By the time she qualifies at 34 the hiring has stopped. Nobody misled her; it was accurate when she acted.
Licensed fields require ongoing hours and fees to stay employable, paid by the worker and assumed by the employer.
